intro: A place for your plans, your people, and the decisions in between.
emptyBody: Create a trip to start planning with your group.
noResultsBody: Try a different name or destination.
name: Trip name
createIntro: Start with the essentials. You can add activities and your travel preferences next.
dateHint: Trips of 1–60 days. Dates use the trip timezone.
invalidDates: Choose a valid range of 1–60 days.
invalidBudget: Enter a non-negative amount with up to 2 decimal places.
invalidTimezone: Enter a valid IANA timezone, such as Asia/Tokyo.
noActivitiesBody: Add the first activity for this day.
noCoordinates: This activity has no map coordinates yet.
budgetIntro: See the trade-offs before you make the decision. This is forecasting, not expense splitting.
estimateNote: Amounts are activity estimates, not paid expenses.
preferenceIntro: Preferences belong to a trip: your budget and pace may change from one journey to the next.
chooseTrip: Choose a trip to set your preferences.
accountIntro: You are signed in. Manage your account below.
notFoundBody: It may have been removed, or you no longer have access.
invalidDuration: Enter a duration from 1 to 1440 minutes.
aiReduceHint: Tripify reads your itinerary and members, then suggests concrete savings. Nothing changes until your group approves a proposal.
aiReducePrompt: Our trip budget is {budget}, planned spending is {planned}, forecast is {forecast} (overrun {overrun}). Suggest specific, concrete ways to reduce spending. Prefer changes that keep every member's top-priority activities. End with the 3 most effective options.
aiReduceFailed: Tripify AI is temporarily unavailable. Your budget is unchanged — try again.
